items.title: 永久免费开源声明：唯一官方发布渠道为 GitHub Releases
items.body: CreditDaddy 是永久免费开源软件（AGPL-3.0），没有付费版。任何付费购买的版本均非官方，请立即申请退款并向平台举报倒卖卖家。
items.titleEn: Free & open-source notice: GitHub Releases is the only official channel
items.bodyEn: CreditDaddy is permanently free and open-source (AGPL-3.0) with no paid edition. Any copy you paid for is unofficial — request a refund immediately and report the reseller.

items.title: 豆包每日签到仅限个人账号，飞书企业号不支持
items.body: 豆包激励任务仅面向个人账号开放，飞书企业账号无法参与；若触发风控拦截（710010702），请在面板点击「打开豆包」使用客户端完成当日签到。
items.titleEn: Doubao daily check-in supports personal accounts only (Feishu enterprise excluded)
items.bodyEn: Doubao's check-in campaign is limited to personal accounts — Feishu enterprise accounts are not eligible. If risk control triggers (710010702), click "Open Doubao" in the panel to complete check-in in the desktop app.

items.title: Croli 产品线已下架，历史账号数据保留只读兼容
items.body: 自 v1.8.4-test.21 起已移除 Croli 渠道的新增、签到及 10Router 同步入口；旧账号库中留存的 Croli 记录仍可安全加载与清理，不会导致报错。
items.titleEn: Croli provider retired; legacy account records remain safely readable
items.bodyEn: Croli support (adding, check-in, and 10Router sync) has been removed since v1.8.4-test.21. Existing Croli entries in your local store remain safely readable for cleanup without errors.

items.title: 支持与 10Router 联动：一键同步账号与外部额度卡
items.body: 在「10Router」页签填写地址与虚拟 Key 后，可将本机托管账号及小米 MiMo / River / ModelScope / LongCat / WPS 灵犀等外部额度卡同步至 10Router。
items.titleEn: 10Router integration: one-click account & external quota card sync
items.bodyEn: Configure your 10Router endpoint and virtual key in the 10Router tab to sync managed accounts and external quota cards (Xiaomi MiMo, River, ModelScope, LongCat, WPS Lingxi) to 10Router.
